items.name: 个人陈述 / SOP 写作
items.description: PS/SOP、动机函、补充短文与说明函的撰写、按项目定制与迭代优化；用具体触发点、可核查数值和逐条项目契合替代模板腔。
items.instructions:
适用：个人陈述 / SOP / 动机函 / 补充短文 / 说明函。
结构（默认 800–1000 词配比，按本次字数上限等比缩放）：缘起 10%（一个具体触发点：一次失败、疑问或任务）→ 学术准备 15%（2–3 个可核查数值与课程名）→ 经历深挖 40%（两段，各写一个案例：问题/根因/动作/结果/反思）→ 项目契合 20%（真实课程名、方向、资源逐条对应经历）→ 目标与收尾 15%（短期角色 + 长期问题域）。
硬规则：
1. 每段一个论点，段首句可独立概括该段；每个形容词后必须有可核查事实支撑。
2. 禁止童年热情（since I was young）、名校赞美（prestigious university / excellent faculty）、widely known / cutting-edge、I believe I am a suitable candidate 等空话。
3. 经历段写「问题 → 根因 → 动作 → 结果（含数值）→ 反思」，不用 participated / gained valuable experience / actively joined 这类无信息量的表述。
4. 契合段必须引用目标项目真实存在的课程或方向，逐条对应自己的经历；官方资料未覆盖的项目级断言不要写。
5. 所有数字、课程名、机构名、时间只取事实台账；缺失一律标 [TO CONFIRM: ...]，绝不估计后提交。
6. 按项目定制时只改项目官方全称、方向措辞、引用课程名、契合段与结尾指向，其余段落逐字不动。
7. 精简时先标出必留数值再删句子，不得按句子长度删到只剩形容词。
8. 说明函 / 解释信首段必须写明用途，不写成正式证明。
items.content:
# 个人陈述与申请文书生成

## 边界
产出 PS/SOP、动机函、限定题目的补充短文、系统强制上传位的说明函、成绩或背景解释信。
不产出推荐信（转 grad-reference-letter）、推荐表评语、简历条目（转 grad-cv-building）。
不虚构经历、成果数值、课程名、导师姓名；不代签、不代提交。

## 输入清单
| 项 | 用途 | 缺失时处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 项目官方全称与页面 | 抬头、契合段 | 标注「待补」，不写缩写猜测 |
| 方向与 specialisation | 契合段落点 | 不写「贵校资源丰富」类替代表述 |
| 字数或页数上限、题目原文 | 结构与分档 | 先询问；用户要求先写则给标准版与精简版两档 |
| 事实来源（CV、成绩单、项目记录、实习证明） | 事实台账 | 无来源的数字一律不写 |
| 语言、提交场景、截止日期 | 排版与收尾 | 标注待补 |

## 事实台账（唯一事实来源）
建表：字段 / 取值 / 来源文件 / 出现段落 / 核实状态。
1. 每个数字（成绩、比例、时长、规模、名次、性能指标）必须在台账中有来源行。
2. 台账外的实体一律写成占位符，不落地成具体名称。
3. 同一事实在 PS、CV、推荐信、推荐表之间取值必须完全一致。
4. 每次修改同步台账，不靠会话记忆复用旧值。

## 结构骨架
默认 800–1000 词配比，按字数上限等比缩放。每段给目的、必含信息、示例句、反例。

| 段 | 目的 | 必含 | 配比 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 缘起 | 给出一个具体触发点 | 一次具体的失败、疑问或任务 | 10% |
| 2 学术准备 | 证明能承受研究生训练 | 2–3 个可核查数值与课程名 | 15% |
| 3–4 经历深挖 | 展示解决问题的方式 | 问题、根因、动作、结果、反思，各一段一个案例 | 40% |
| 5 项目契合 | 把经历接到目标项目 | 真实课程名、方向、资源，逐条对应 | 20% |
| 6 目标与收尾 | 说明读完要做什么 | 短期角色与长期问题域 | 15% |

示例句与反例：

| 位置 | 示例句（占位符） | 反例（禁止） |
|---|---|---|
| 缘起 | `In <Course Name> I implemented <method> and found it failed when <condition>; that failure set the direction of my work.` | `I have been passionate about <field> since I was young.` |
| 学术准备 | `I ranked <Metric> in <cohort descriptor> and scored <Value A> and <Value B> in <Course A> and <Course B>.` | `I have a solid academic foundation.` |
| 经历 | `When <problem> produced <symptom>, I traced it to <root cause> by <method>, then <action>, reducing <metric> from <v1> to <v2>. The result made me question <assumption>.` | `I actively participated in the project and gained valuable experience.` |
| 契合 | `<Course Name> in <Programme Name> covers <topic>, which is exactly where the <problem> in my <project> sits.` | `Your prestigious university has excellent faculty and resources.` |
| 目标 | `I intend to work on <specific problem> in <setting>, starting as <role>.` | `I hope to contribute to the development of <field>.` |
| 收尾 | 一句收束，不重复前文、不再表态 | `I believe I am a suitable candidate.` |

## 按项目定制
可变字段：项目官方全称、方向措辞、引用的课程名、契合段、结尾指向。
不可变字段：所有数字、经历、时间、方法名、结果、反思。

替换示例：
```
旧: ... admission to the <Programme A>, <University A>.
新: ... admission to the <Programme B>, <University B>.
```
其余段落逐字不动。规则：替换对按字符串长度降序执行，防止长串被短串部分匹配；替换后统计命中次数，命中为 0 立即停止并报告；改完做 diff，确认差异行数等于可变字段数。

## 迭代优化
一次只处理一类问题，不混合改动。

**字数压缩示例（同一段三档）**
```
[标准 118 词] 含完整背景句、两处修饰语、一句自我评价、一句展望
[精简 74 词]  删除背景句与自我评价，保留 2 个数值、方法名、结果、反思
[极致 46 词]  合并根因与动作，保留 1 个最关键数值与结果，反思压成半句
```
删的顺序：修饰语 → 重复背景 → 评价性尾巴 → 展望句。保留的顺序：数值 → 方法名 → 结果 → 反思。禁止整段删除核心经历、禁止删掉数字。

**去模板腔对照**
| 空话 | 改写 |
|---|---|
| `I am a highly motivated and diligent person.` | `I rebuilt <component> twice after <metric> missed <target>.` |
| `This experience taught me the importance of teamwork.` | `I split <task> with <role> and reconciled <artifact> weekly, which cut <metric>.` |
| `I gained a deeper understanding of <field>.` | `I switched from <method A> to <method B> after <evidence>.` |
| `not only <X> but also <Y>` | 拆成两个带主语的短句 |
| `various / numerous / a wide range of` | 换成具体数量或两项列举 |
| `It is widely known that ...` | 整句删除 |
| `I learned X. I learned Y. I learned Z.` | 保留证据最强的一条，展开因果 |
| `Under the guidance of <Referee Name> I made great progress.` | `<Referee Name> questioned <claim>; I reran <experiment> with <control>.` |
| `I am confident I can succeed in your programme.` | 删除，用证据句收尾 |
| `state-of-the-art / cutting-edge / world-class` | 换成具体技术名或删 |

**逻辑补连接**：在经历段与契合段之间插入一句 `<Programme Name>'s <Course Name> covers <topic>, which is where the <problem> above sits.`，不另起议论段。

## 子类型：说明函与解释信（一页英文）
系统强制上传位但用户确无对应材料时，写占位说明函：
```
Applicant Statement — <Subject>
<Programme Name> | <University>

I am applying for <Programme Name>. According to <official source>, <document type>
is not required for admission assessment. This document is submitted solely to
satisfy a mandatory upload field in the application system. My highest academic
qualification is <qualification> at <Institution>. All academic materials required
for assessment are provided under <section name>.

Applicant Name: <Applicant Name>
Application No.: <Application No.>
```
规则：不辩解、不写情绪、不重复已在他处提交的信息；必须含姓名与申请号；纯英文、单页、无密码。
解释信结构：一句客观事实 → 一句可核查原因 → 一句后续证据 → 结束，不写长篇致歉。

## 质量检查清单
- [ ] 项目全称与官网逐字一致，含大小写、括号、时制后缀
- [ ] 字数在限制内，压缩后仍含全部关键数值
- [ ] 每段一个论点，段首句可独立概括该段
- [ ] 每个形容词后有可核查事实支撑
- [ ] 无童年热情、名校赞美、widely known、cutting-edge 类句
- [ ] 引用的课程与方向真实存在于项目页面
- [ ] 台账取值与 CV、推荐信、推荐表一致
- [ ] 多项目版本仅可变字段不同，diff 已核
- [ ] 已备份上一版，文件名带递增版本号
- [ ] 导出后 PDF 文本可复制、页数符合预期

## 常见失败模式
| 现象 | 原因 | 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| 多版本事实漂移 | 定制时顺手润色 | 只改矩阵内字段，改后 diff |
| 精简后只剩形容词 | 按句子长度删而非按信息删 | 先标出必留数值再压 |
| 契合段泛泛 | 未读项目页面 | 引用具体课程逐条对应经历 |
| 项目名缩写与全称混用 | 台账未存唯一全称 | 台账存唯一全称，替换从台账取 |
| 说明函被当正式证明 | 未写明用途 | 首段写明仅为满足系统必填 |

## 通用化约定
占位符：<Applicant Name>、<Programme Name>、<University>、<Course Name>、<Metric>、<Value>、<Date>。
全部实体不落地；关键数值不代填，缺失标注「待确认」。

## 资源
`references/examples.md`：完整骨架模板、说明函全文、20 条改写对照、字数三档完整示例。
items.examples:
# PS 写作示例库（全占位符，无真实实体）

## 1. 完整骨架模板
```
<Applicant Name>
Statement of Purpose — <Programme Name>, <University>

[1 缘起]
In <Course Name> I implemented <method> for <task>. It failed whenever
<condition>, and the failure was not in <obvious place> but in <root cause>.
That gap is what I have been working on since.

[2 学术准备]
My preparation is quantitative: <Metric> in <cohort descriptor>, with
<Value A> in <Course A> and <Value B> in <Course B>. <Course C> gave me
<specific tool>, which I used in <later project>.

[3 经历一]
On <project>, <problem> produced <symptom>. Rather than <common fix>, I
<diagnostic method> and found <root cause>. I then <action>, moving <metric>
from <v1> to <v2> and shipping <artifact> in <environment>. The result made me
question <assumption>, which I tested by <follow-up>.

[4 经历二]
In <second setting>, the constraint was <constraint>. I designed <design>,
including <component A> and <component B>, and handled <failure mode> with
<mitigation>. <Outcome> reached <metric>. What I took away was <insight about
the field>, not just a working system.

[5 契合]
<Programme Name> is the right place for the next step because <Course X>
covers <topic> that <experience above> stopped short of, and <specialisation>
matches <specific problem>. I want to work through <method> under conditions
our <environment> could not provide.

[6 目标]
After the programme I intend to work on <specific problem> in <setting>,
starting as <role>. <One-sentence close, no restatement.>
```

## 2. 说明函完整模板
见 SKILL.md「子类型」小节；字段名与占位符保持一致，不新增实体。

## 3. 改写对照（20 条）
| 空话 | 改写 |
|---|---|
| I have always been fascinated by <field>. | In <Course Name>, <method> failed under <condition>; that failure defined my interest. |
| I possess strong analytical skills. | I isolated <root cause> by <diagnostic method> before changing <component>. |
| I worked hard to overcome difficulties. | After <metric> missed <target>, I rebuilt <component> twice over <duration>. |
| I am a fast learner. | I read <source type> and shipped <artifact> <duration> after starting <topic>. |
| This project broadened my horizons. | The project moved <metric> from <v1> to <v2> and exposed <limitation>. |
| I contributed significantly to the team. | I owned <component>, which <downstream> depended on in <environment>. |
| I have excellent communication skills. | I wrote <artifact> that <role> used to <action> without further clarification. |
| The university's reputation attracted me. | <Course X> and <specialisation> cover <topic> my <project> could not address. |
| I want to learn from world-class professors. | <Research area> in <Programme Name> matches <specific problem> from <project>. |
| I gained hands-on experience. | I deployed <artifact> in <environment> at <metric>. |
| We successfully completed the project. | <Artifact> went into <environment> with <metric> and <failure mitigation>. |
| I am passionate about innovation. | I replaced <method A> with <method B> after <evidence>. |
| This taught me the value of persistence. | Three attempts at <action> failed on <cause>; the fourth used <different method>. |
| I am well-rounded. | I balanced <commitment A> with <commitment B> across <duration>, keeping <metric>. |
| I hope to make a difference. | I intend to work on <specific problem> in <setting>. |
| My strengths include diligence and curiosity. | 删；直接写下一句证据 |
| It was a challenging but rewarding journey. | 删 |
| I believe my background aligns well. | 删，用契合段的具体课程对应替代 |
| Various techniques were explored. | I compared <method A>, <method B> and <method C>; <method B> won on <metric>. |
| In today's rapidly developing world, <field> is important. | 删 |

## 4. 字数三档完整示例
```
[标准 118 词]
During <project> I was responsible for <component>, a part of the system that
had been behaving unreliably for some time and that several people had already
tried to fix. I began by <diagnostic method>, which showed that the real cause
was <root cause> rather than <assumed cause>. I then redesigned <component>
around <method>, added <mitigation> for <failure mode>, and measured the result
in <environment>. <Metric> fell from <v1> to <v2>, and <artifact> was handed
over in a usable state. Looking back, the important lesson was not the fix
itself but that <insight>, an assumption I have since tested again in <setting>.
In my view this is the kind of problem I want to keep working on.

[精简 74 词] 删背景句、自我评价、展望句
On <project>, <component> was unreliable. <Diagnostic method> located
<root cause> rather than <assumed cause>. I redesigned it around <method>,
added <mitigation> for <failure mode>, and measured it in <environment>:
<metric> fell from <v1> to <v2> and <artifact> shipped. What stayed with me
was <insight>, which I later tested again in <setting>.

[极致 46 词] 合并根因与动作、保留一个数值
<Component> failed because of <root cause>, not <assumed cause>. I redesigned
it with <method> and <mitigation>; <metric> fell from <v1> to <v2> in
<environment>. That result exposed <insight>, which I later retested.
```
三档都保留：根因、方法、数值、结果、反思。差异只在背景与评价性句子。

## 5. 可复制检查表
见 SKILL.md「质量检查清单」；每次交付前逐条打勾，未通过项写进交付说明，不静默略过。

items.name: 学术 CV 构建
items.description: 学术型简历的板块与条目写法、动词开头的成果表述、中英双语版本一致性；禁用职责描述式空话。
items.instructions:
适用：学术 CV / 简历条目与中英双语版本。
硬规则：
1. 板块按时间倒序，日期格式全篇统一；相关性低的板块整体删除，不留空标题。
2. 每条 1–2 行，动词开头（过去式）：按贡献类型选 built / designed / implemented / deployed、traced / isolated / profiled、reduced / restructured、led / owned、shipped / published / presented。
3. 条目 = 动作 + 结果 + 可核查数值（或交付物 / 环境）；数值只取事实台账，无数值时不硬凑百分比。
4. 禁用 responsible for、participated in、helped with、worked on、gained experience、familiar with 长工具清单、excellent teamwork and leadership。
5. 机构与项目名用官方英文名；技能按类别分组，只列能举出用例的工具；不要用进度条。
6. 中英两版条目数与数值逐条对齐；所有数值须与 PS、推荐信一致。
7. 页数与版式服从本次生成要求；不编造成果或职务，不把参与写成主导。
items.content:
# 学术 CV 生成与迭代

## 边界
产出面向研究生申请的学术 CV：条目、板块、双语对照、版本链。
不产出 PS 叙述段落（转 grad-sop-writing）、不编造成果或职务、不把参与写成主导。

## 输入清单
目标项目类型（研究型/授课型）、语言、页数上限、事实来源（成绩单、项目记录、证明）、
已有版本号、需新增或删除的条目、姓名与日期的官方拼写。缺项标注「待补」。

## 板块顺序与条目模板
倒序排列，日期格式全篇统一（如 `MMM YYYY – MMM YYYY`）。相关性低的板块整体删除，不留空标题。

| 板块 | 条目模板（占位符） |
|---|---|
| 教育 | `<Institution>, <Degree> in <Major>, <Date Range> · <Metric> · <Core Course A>, <Core Course B>` |
| 研究 | `<Role>, <Project>, <Unit>, <Date Range> · <method> → <result> (<metric>)` |
| 实习 | `<Role>, <Organisation>, <Date Range> · <component> shipped in <environment>, <metric>` |
| 项目 | `<Project Name> · <stack> · <action>, <failure mitigation>, <outcome>` |
| 成果 | `<Type>, <Title>, <Venue/Status>, <Date>` |
| 奖项 | `<Award Name>, <Issuer>, <Date> · <selection basis>` |
| 技能 | `<Category>: <item A>, <item B>` 分组列举，不用进度条 |
| 语言 | `<Test>, <Score>, <Date>` |

## 条目改写规则
1. 动词开头，过去式描述已完成事项；按贡献类型选词：
   - 构建：`built / designed / implemented / deployed`
   - 诊断：`traced / isolated / profiled / attributed`
   - 优化：`reduced / restructured / cached / batched`
   - 主导：`led / owned / coordinated`
   - 交付：`shipped / handed over / maintained`
   - 产出：`published / filed / presented`
2. 每条一到两行；先写动作，再写结果，再写可核查数值。
3. 数值只来自事实台账；无数值时写可核查的交付物或环境，不硬凑百分比。
4. 不使用 `responsible for`、`participated in`、`helped with`、`worked on`。

改写对照：
| 空话 | 改写 |
|---|---|
| `Responsible for backend development.` | `Built <component> with <stack>; handled <concern> for <scale>.` |
| `Participated in <project> and improved performance.` | `Profiled <bottleneck>, restructured <component>, cut <metric> from <v1> to <v2>.` |
| `Gained experience in <technology>.` | `Deployed <artifact> with <technology> in <environment>.` |
| `Assisted the team with data processing.` | `Wrote <pipeline> that processed <volume> and repaired <failure mode>.` |
| `Excellent teamwork and leadership.` | 删；改在「主导」类条目里写具体分工 |
| `Familiar with <long list of tools>.` | 按类别分组，只列能举出用例的工具 |

## 双语一致性
建对照表逐条核对：数值、日期、专有名词官方英文名、机构名、角色名。
机构与项目名采用官方英文名，不自译；中文版与英文版条目数量一致；
两版同一事实不得出现不同取值。对照表随每次修改更新。

## 版本链
每次实质改动另存为递增版本，文件名标注语言与版本（如 `<Document Name>-EN-v3.docx`），
前一版移入备份目录，不覆盖。版本记录表：
`版本 / 改动类型 / 涉及板块 / 改动前后差异摘要 / 事实来源 / 日期`。

典型迭代序列（通用描述，不含具体事实）：
`v1 骨架 → v2 补量化结果 → v3 补成果与奖项 → v4 补长期承诺类经历 → v5 双语对齐与排版收紧`。

## 版式约束
字号 10–11pt、页边距不小于 1.5cm、一至两页；不用照片、图标栏、技能进度条、
彩色模板、表格嵌套版式；PDF 导出后文本须可选中、字体无缺失。

一页与两页取舍：经历少于 6 条或申请授课型项目优先一页；研究型项目或成果列表较长用两页，
第二页至少占三分之一，否则收紧到一页。

## 质量检查清单
- [ ] 全篇倒序、日期格式统一、无空板块
- [ ] 每条动词开头，无 `responsible for` 类句
- [ ] 所有数值与事实台账一致，且与 PS、推荐信一致
- [ ] 中英两版条目数与取值逐条对齐
- [ ] 机构与项目名用官方英文名
- [ ] 版本号递增、前一版已备份
- [ ] 页数符合限制，第二页不空疏
- [ ] PDF 文本可复制、无字体缺失

## 常见失败模式
| 现象 | 原因 | 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| 中英数值不一致 | 两版分别手改 | 先改台账，再按对照表同步两版 |
| 条目像岗位说明书 | 用职责描述代替结果 | 改成动作 + 结果 + 数值 |
| 越改越长 | 每次新增不删旧 | 每轮设定删减目标条数 |
| 引用非官方证明里的数值 | 截图当正式来源 | 只采信官方成绩单，截图标注为辅助 |
| 版本混乱 | 直接覆盖定稿 | 递增版本号 + 备份目录 |

## 通用化约定
占位符：<Applicant Name>、<Institution>、<Degree>、<Metric>、<Role>、<Organisation>、<Date>、<Metric Value>。

## 资源
`references/examples.md`：完整一页 CV 骨架、条目改写 20 条、双语对照表模板、版本记录表模板。

items.name: 推荐信撰写
items.description: 以推荐人第一人称写推荐信，用观察→动作→结果→评价的案例链支撑评价，并安全管理多项目抬头变体。
items.instructions:
适用：以推荐人第一人称写成的推荐信，以及面向多院校 / 多项目的变体。
结构：关系与观察范围 → 带比较池的总评 → 学术 / 能力（含数值）→ 案例一（情境 → 诊断 → 动作 → 结果含数值）→ 案例二或自学证据 → 1–2 个有案例支撑的特质 → 成长空间 → 无保留推荐收束。
硬规则：
1. 证据写法 = 观察 → 动作 → 结果（可核查数值或交付物）→ 评价，四句缺一即为空泛。
2. 禁止 outstanding student with great potential、works independently、a pleasure to supervise 等无案例评价；收束的强推荐必须由前置至少两个带数值案例支撑。
3. 项目名使用官方全称，含括号内容、时制后缀、stream / specialisation，不可混用简称。
4. 多项目变体只改抬头与项目全称，扫描全文所有出现位置并逐段比对；数字、经历、时间、方法名、结果、反思等不可变字段逐字不动。
5. 学术推荐人与业界推荐人视角分开，案例不雷同。
6. 署名、职称、单位、联系方式等缺失信息标 [TO CONFIRM: ...]，不编造；产出为供推荐人本人核对提交的参考稿。
items.content:
# 推荐信生成与多项目变体

## 边界
产出以推荐人第一人称写成的推荐信，以及同一推荐人面向不同院校/项目的变体。
不产出申请人自述（转 grad-sop-writing）、不产出推荐表逐题答案。
推荐信由推荐人本人通过其账号提交；本技能产出的是给推荐人的参考稿，不代填、不代传。

## 输入清单
基准信全文、推荐人角色与视角、项目官方全称与所属院系、收件抬头格式、
需生成的目标项目清单、命名约定、是否需要同名 PDF。缺项标注「待补」，不推断。

## 事实台账
从基准信抽取并登记：推荐人身份与认识起止时间、申请人成绩与排名数值、
课程与成绩、经历与时间段、具体案例（问题、动作、结果）、评价用语、
署名、职称、单位、联系方式。台账是唯一事实来源，变体不得引入台账外信息。

## 可变 / 不可变矩阵
| 可变 | 不可变 |
|---|---|
| 收件抬头中的院校名 | 所有成绩、排名、课程分数 |
| 项目官方全称（含括号、时制后缀、stream 名） | 经历、时间段、案例细节 |
| 院系名 | 评价用语与推荐强度 |
| 正文首句与结尾的项目指向 | 推荐人署名、职称、单位、联系方式 |

替换示例：
```
旧抬头: Admissions Committee, <Programme A>, <University A>
新抬头: Admissions Committee, <Programme B>, <University B>
旧首句: I write to recommend <Applicant Name> for admission to <Programme A>.
新首句: I write to recommend <Applicant Name> for admission to <Programme B>.
```
其余段落逐字不动。规则：项目全称逐字匹配官方写法；替换对按长度降序执行；
命中次数为 0 时停止并报告；替换后核验「含全部新值、不含任何旧值」且不可变字段逐字一致。

## 推荐信结构骨架
```
<Referee Name> | <Designation> | <Organisation> | <Contact>

<Date>
Admissions Committee
<Programme Name>, <University>

Dear Admissions Committee,

[1 关系] I have known <Applicant Name> since <Date> as <capacity>.
        Over <duration> I observed <scope>.
[2 总评] <One evaluative sentence tied to a comparison pool.>
[3 学术/能力] <Metric>, <Course A> <Value A>, <Course B> <Value B>.
[4 案例一] <Situation> → <diagnosis> → <action> → <result with metric>.
[5 案例二或自学证据] <Self-directed behaviour> → <specific question asked> → <follow-up>.
[6 特质] <One or two traits>, each tied to a case above.
[7 成长空间] <Gap stated as developmental> → why a structured programme is the next step.
[8 收束] <Unreserved recommendation> + offer to be contacted.

Sincerely,
<Referee Name>
```

## 推荐人视角差异
| 维度 | 学术推荐人 | 业界推荐人 |
|---|---|---|
| 可写 | 课程成绩、量化基础、研讨追问、自学路径、班级比较池 | 交付物、系统设计、性能指标、上线环境、实习生比较池 |
| 不可写 | 生产环境细节、公司评价口径 | GPA、课程分数、班级排名 |
| 证据形态 | 分数、论文讨论、实验复现 | 延迟、有效率、并发、交付时间 |
| 比较池 | 近年指导的本科生 | 直接带过的实习生或初级工程师 |

同一事实不跨视角套用；两封推荐信的案例不重复，形成互补而非复述。

## 证据写法
把一段经历写成四句，缺一句即为空泛评价：
`观察（看到什么现象） → 动作（做了什么诊断或实现） → 结果（可核查数值或交付物） → 评价（由此推出什么特质）`。

对照：
| 空话 | 改写 |
|---|---|
| `He is an outstanding student with great potential.` | `In <Course A> he scored <Value>; when <classifier> failed on <condition>, he returned to <data> and found <root cause>.` |
| `She works independently.` | `Given <open-ended task>, she returned <artifact> in <environment> without further specification.` |
| `He is a quick learner.` | `Six months after writing <component A>, he designed <component B> himself from <source type>.` |
| `A pleasure to supervise.` | 删，换成一次具体追问的内容 |
| `I strongly recommend him without hesitation.` | 保留作收束，但前面必须有案例支撑，不作独立段落 |

## 项目名精确化
名称相近但定位不同的项目按独立抬头处理，不复用同一全称；
括号内容、时制后缀、stream 或 specialisation 名属于全称的一部分，不可省略；
给文件名附项目中文名时只作人工核对用，不改正文英文全称。

## 命名与核验
命名：`<Referee Name>-<University Abbr>-<Programme Abbr>（<中文项目名>）.docx`，同目录保留同名 PDF。
生成方式：复制基准信 → 只替换矩阵内字段 → 另存，绝不改写原件。
核验清单：
- [ ] 新抬头与正文项目指向均为目标项目官方全称
- [ ] 无残留旧院校名、旧项目名
- [ ] 不可变字段与基准信逐字一致（逐段比对，不只看摘要）
- [ ] 推荐人视角未串用（学术/业界）
- [ ] 署名、职称、单位、联系方式完整
- [ ] 原件未被修改，新文件版本号或项目标识清晰

## 常见失败模式
| 现象 | 原因 | 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| 抬头改了正文没改 | 只替换首个匹配 | 扫描全文所有出现位置，统计命中数 |
| 变体之间事实漂移 | 生成时顺手润色 | 只改矩阵内字段，改后逐段比对 |
| 项目全称缺后缀 | 用了简称 | 台账存官方全称，替换从台账取 |
| 两封推荐信内容雷同 | 同一案例重复用 | 按视角分派不同案例 |
| 推荐强度无支撑 | 收束段独立成段 | 前置至少两个带数值的案例 |
| 申请人代提交 | 流程误解 | 交付说明中写明由推荐人本人提交 |

## 通用化约定
占位符：<Referee Name>、<Applicant Name>、<University>、<Programme Name>、<Designation>、<Organisation>、<Metric>。

## 资源
`references/examples.md`：完整推荐信骨架（学术版与业界版）、视角分派表、改写对照 15 条、变体核验 diff 示例。
items.examples:
# 推荐信示例库（全占位符）

## 1. 学术推荐人完整骨架
```
<Referee Name>, <Designation>
<Organisation> | <Contact>
<Date>

Admissions Committee, <Programme Name>, <University>

Dear Admissions Committee,

I have known <Applicant Name> since <Date>, when <enrolment event>, and have
served as <capacity> throughout <duration>. In that role I have seen both
<scope A> and <scope B>.

<Applicant Name> is <evaluative claim tied to comparison pool>. The evidence
is quantitative: <Metric> overall, with <Value A> in <Course A> and
<Value B> in <Course B>.

What distinguishes <Applicant Name> is how <behaviour>. When <problem>
produced <symptom>, <pronoun> did not <common fix>; <pronoun> returned to
<data> and traced it to <root cause> before <action>. The result was
<outcome with metric>.

<Second case: self-directed study.> Much of <topic> lies outside our
curriculum; <pronoun> learned it from <source type> and came back with
<specific question>, having already tried <attempt> and followed up with
<follow-up>. Few undergraduates here do that unprompted.

<Trait sentence tied to a case above.> <Optional second trait with evidence.>

<Developmental gap, stated forward-looking.> This is not a reservation; it is
why a structured <Programme Name> is the right next step.

I recommend <Applicant Name> without reservation and would be glad to answer
any further questions.

Sincerely,
<Referee Name>
```

## 2. 业界推荐人完整骨架
```
<Referee Name>, <Designation>
<Organisation> | <Contact>
<Date>

Admissions Committee, <Programme Name>, <University>

Dear Admissions Committee,

I supervised <Applicant Name> directly through <placement A, Date Range> and
<placement B, Date Range>, roughly <duration> of hands-on work. My comparison
pool is the <pool descriptor> I have supervised in recent years.

In <placement A> <pronoun> built <component> with <stack>, turning <input>
into <output>. By <placement B> <pronoun> independently designed <system>,
including <component A>, <component B> and <component C>, and modularised
<part> into reusable pipelines.

The way <pronoun> reasons is the point. Faced with <latency> of <v1>,
<pronoun> did not accept it as the cost of <operation>; <pronoun>
restructured <process> with <technique> and brought <metric> to <v2>.
<pronoun> also engineered for failure: <mitigation> for <failure mode>, and
the system reached <validity> in <environment>. <Pronoun> handed over running
software, not a demo.

<Second case: system-level design.> On <workflow>, <pronoun> co-built
<design> that bounds <scope> and requires <check> before <output>, while
handling <concurrency concern>.

<Developmental gap: formal grounding.> <Pronoun> reaches sound solutions
intuitively and is still acquiring the depth to generalise them, which is why
graduate study rather than another <placement> is the right next step.

Very few <pool descriptor> can be given an open-ended problem and trusted to
return production-ready code; <Applicant Name> can. I recommend <pronoun>
without reservation for <Programme Name>.

Sincerely,
<Referee Name>
```

## 3. 视角分派表（避免两封信重复）
| 案例 | 学术推荐人 | 业界推荐人 |
|---|---|---|
| 成绩与量化课程 | 用 | 不用 |
| 班级比较池 | 用 | 不用 |
| 自学与追问 | 用 | 可轻描，不占主段 |
| 生产交付与指标 | 不用 | 用 |
| 并发、权限、降级 | 不用 | 用 |
| 实习比较池 | 不用 | 用 |
| 长期课外承诺 | 用 | 不用 |

## 4. 改写对照 15 条
| 空话 | 改写 |
|---|---|
| He is an excellent student. | `<Metric> overall, <Value> in <Course A>, <pass count> modules.` |
| She shows great potential. | `Between <placement A> and <placement B>, she moved from <component A> to designing <system>.` |
| Hard-working and diligent. | `She rebuilt <component> twice after <metric> missed <target>.` |
| Good at problem solving. | `He traced <symptom> to <root cause> with <method> before changing anything.` |
| A quick learner. | `She shipped <artifact> <duration> after first reading <source type>.` |
| Works well independently. | `Given <open-ended task>, he returned <artifact> in <environment>.` |
| Strong theoretical grounding. | `<Value A> and <Value B> in <Course A> and <Course B>.` |
| Contributed to the team. | `He owned <component>; <downstream> depended on it in <environment>.` |
| Has good research sense. | `She asked <specific question> about <evaluation method>, having tried <attempt>.` |
| Handles pressure well. | `He balanced <commitment> with <commitment> across <duration>, keeping <metric>.` |
| Communicates effectively. | `She wrote <artifact> that <role> used without clarification.` |
| Mature beyond his years. | 删，换成一次具体判断 |
| One of the best I have seen. | `Among <pool size> <pool descriptor>, <pronoun> is one of <n> I would <specific action>.` |
| I am sure he will succeed. | 删，用收束句 |
| No weaknesses to speak of. | `<Gap> stated developmentally + why the programme addresses it.` |

## 5. 变体核验 diff 示例
```
--- baseline (Programme A)          +++ variant (Programme B)
-Admissions Committee, <Programme A>, <University A>
+Admissions Committee, <Programme B>, <University B>
-I write to recommend <Applicant Name> for admission to <Programme A>.
+I write to recommend <Applicant Name> for admission to <Programme B>.
 ... 其余行 identical ...
```
期望差异行数 = 2（抬头 + 首句），若出现第 3 行差异则判定为意外润色，回滚重做。
